legend: You have a tree with $$$n$$$ vertices ($$$1 \leq n \leq 10^5$$$), numbered from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$ and rooted at node $$$1$$$. Every node $$$i$$$ has an integer value $$$a_i$$$ ($$$0 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$$$).

You can update the values of the nodes $$$q$$$ times ($$$1 \leq q \leq 1000$$$). In the $$$i$$$-th update, you can choose a subset of nodes and increase the value of all of them by $$$x_i$$$ ($$$1 \leq x_i \leq 1000$$$).

You task is to use these updates to convert the tree into a heap. The tree is considered a heap if and only if every non-root node has a value less than or equal to the value of its parent. Since there can be multiple ways to do this, you must choose the one that minimizes $$$\sum_{i=1}^n a_i$$$.
input: The first line of input contains two space separated integers: $$$n$$$ and $$$q$$$.
The second line contains $$$n$$$ space separated integers: $$$a_i$$$.
Each of the next $$$n-1$$$ lines describe the edges of the tree, each contains two space separated integers: $$$u$$$ and $$$v$$$ (Meaning there is an edge between $$$u$$$ and $$$v$$$).
The next and final line of input contains $$$q$$$ space separated integers: $$$x_i$$$.
output: If there is a way to convert the tree into a heap, output the minimum $$$\sum_{i=1}^n a_i$$$ after converting it to a heap. Otherwise output -1.

legend.ai: 你有一棵包含 $$$n$$$ 个顶点的树($$$1 \leq n \leq 10^5$$$)，其顶点编号从 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$n$$$，根节点为 $$$1$$$。每个节点 $$$i$$$ 都有一个整数值 $$$a_i$$$($$$0 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$$$)。
你可以更新节点的值 $$$q$$$ 次($$$1 \leq q \leq 1000$$$)。在第 $$$i$$$ 次更新中，你可以选择一个节点子集，并将其中所有节点的值增加 $$$x_i$$$($$$1 \leq x_i \leq 1000$$$)。
你的任务是通过这些更新将这棵树转换为堆。当且仅当每个非根节点的值都小于或等于其父节点的值时，这棵树才被视为堆。由于可能有多种转换方式，你必须选择使 $$$\sum_{i=1}^n a_i$$$ 最小的方案。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含两个由空格分隔的整数：$$$n$$$ 和 $$$q$$$。
第二行包含 $$$n$$$ 个空格分隔的整数：$$$a_i$$$。
接下来的 $$$n-1$$$ 行中的每一行描述树的一条边，每行包含两个以空格分隔的整数：$$$u$$$ 和 $$$v$$$(表示 $$$u$$$ 和 $$$v$$$ 之间存在一条边)。
输入的下一行也是最后一行，包含 $$$q$$$ 个以空格分隔的整数：$$$x_i$$$。

output.ai: 如果可以将这棵树转换为堆，则输出转换为堆后最小的 $$$\sum_{i=1}^n a_i$$$。否则输出 -1。
